title: Length of Service of Foreign Nurses Employed at Restructured Hospitals
what_it_is: Length of Service of Foreign Nurses Employed at Restructured Hospitals

sections.label: Nurse median and average years
sections.summary: Between 2014 and 2021, median nurse years rose from five to eight and average from seven to 10, with actual figures likely higher.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Between 2014 and 2021, the median increased from five to eight years, whilst the average increased from seven to 10 years.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: The actual median and average figures should be higher as the existing data does not take into account nurses who switched hospitals but remained in the public healthcare sector.

sections.label: Target 82,000 healthcare staff by 2030
sections.summary: Minister Ong Ye Kung indicated a target of 82,000 nurses, allied health and support care staff by 2030, up from 58,000 today.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: Minister Ong Ye Kung had also given an indication of these numbers, extensively, during the debate on the White Paper.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: We are looking at, by 2030, to have 82,000 nurses, allied health and support care staff, up from the 58,000 that we have today.

sections.label: Increase from 2,100 to 2,300
sections.summary: This number will increase over time, from about 2,100 to 2,300.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: This is also going to be increased over time.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: We have about 2,100 from them and we are looking at increasing to 2,300.

sections.label: Approach and 2030 timing
sections.summary: The approach and timing have been explained, indicating a total of 82,000 by 2030.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: I have also repeatedly explained what our approach is.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: We have given an indication of timing, which is by 2030, to have 82,000 in total.

sections.label: Target 82,000 healthcare workers by 2030
sections.summary: The target is 82,000 healthcare workers by 2030 for Healthier SG, through overseas recruitment, nurse well-being, career pathways and job redesigns.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: As I have explained, we have a target of 82,000 of all workers – nurses, allied health as well as all the other necessary workers in the healthcare sector.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: We have already set the target by 2030 because we are working towards Healthier SG.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: We have already explained in many of those questions that were put earlier, the different ways in which we are doing this.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: We are recruiting from overseas, we are improving the well-being of the nurses here, we are improving the career pathways, we are supporting them with the different job redesigns to facilitate their workflow.
